SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::NUMERIC / SUM(anglers)::NUMERIC, 3) as avg_yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'day_1_5' 
  AND fish_date_season = 2
  AND fish_date_doy >= 260
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
LIMIT 50;

FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2

s2_long = trips_df[(trips_df['fish_date_season'] == 2) & 
                    (trips_df['cls'].isin(['day_1_5', 'multi_day']))].copy()

# Calculate per-angler yield by doy
s2_long['yt_per_angler'] = s2_long['yt'] / s2_long['anglers']

perf_by_doy = s2_long.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt_per_angler': ['mean', 'median', 'count'],
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).round(3)
